title: Assam Legislative Assembly 2026 (holdout)

NDA.note: BJP+AGP as 2021; BPF SWITCHED from 2021 Mahajot to NDA (11 seats in BTR) -> tau both scopes (BPF fought GE2024 outside the NDA seat deal too). UPPL LEFT the NDA (no seat talks, contesting alone) -> excluded despite being a 2021/GE2024 NDA member

ASOM.note: Asom Sonmilito Morcha, Congress-led 8-party front revived Nov 2025: INC, CPM (both with INC in 2021 Mahajot -> 1), AJP (contested alone 2021, 3.76 -> tau), CPIML, APHLC (no data). Raijor Dal LEFT over seats, Mar 2026. AIUDF and BPF, 2021 Mahajot members, are both OUT

AIUDF.note: contesting alone (9 declared at freeze); own-vote baseline 9.56 (AE2021) / 3.16 (GE2024)
